import copy, json, subprocess, sys

BASE = json.load(open("/workspace/examples/input.json"))

def run(text):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/main.py"],
                       input=text if isinstance(text, bytes) else text.encode(),
                       capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"), p.stderr.decode("utf-8","replace")[:200]

def expect_invalid(name, text):
    rc, out, err = run(text)
    if rc != 0 or out != '{"error":"invalid-input"}':
        print("FAIL(invalid expected)", name, "rc=", rc, "out=", out[:200])
        return False
    return True

def expect_valid(name, text):
    rc, out, err = run(text)
    if rc != 0:
        print("FAIL(valid expected)", name, "rc=", rc, out[:300], err[:300]); return False
    try:
        json.loads(out)
    except Exception as e:
        print("FAIL(valid json)", name, e, out[:200]); return False
    return True

def mutate(path, fn):
    d = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    fn(d)
    return json.dumps(d)

results = []
def T(name, text): results.append(expect_invalid(name, text))
def V(name, text): results.append(expect_valid(name, text))

# ---- top-level / JSON-level ----
T("empty input", b"")
T("whitespace only", b"   \n\t ")
T("not json", b"{")
T("trailing garbage", json.dumps(BASE) + " x")
T("two docs", json.dumps(BASE) + json.dumps(BASE))
T("root list", "[]")
T("root string", '"hi"')
T("root null", "null")
T("root number", "5")
T("nan", '{"version":1}')
T("dup root key", '{"version":1,"version":1}')
T("non utf8", b'{"version":1,\xff}')
T("bom", b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + json.dumps(BASE).encode())
T("deep nesting", "[" * 100000 + "]" * 100000)
T("deep nesting obj", '{"a":' * 50000 + '1' + '}' * 50000)
T("huge input", b" " * (16*1024*1024 + 1))
V("16MiB exactly-ish", b" " * (16*1024*1024 - len(json.dumps(BASE))) + json.dumps(BASE).encode())

# ---- root keys ----
T("missing version", mutate(None, lambda d: d.pop("version")))
T("extra root key", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"extra": 1})))
T("version 2", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"version": 2})))
T("version bool", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"version": True})))
T("version float", '{"version":1.0,"config":%s,"model":%s,"connections":%s,"packets":%s}' % (
    json.dumps(BASE["config"]), json.dumps(BASE["model"]), json.dumps(BASE["connections"]), json.dumps(BASE["packets"])))
T("version string", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"version": "1"})))
T("version null", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"version": None})))

# ---- config ----
CK = ["slots","window","idle_timeout","len_quantum","gap_quantum","rate_num","rate_den",
      "bucket_capacity","initial_tokens","pending_capacity","lanes","service","fallback",
      "time_edges","count_edges","probability"]
for k in CK:
    T("config missing "+k, mutate(None, lambda d, k=k: d["config"].pop(k)))
T("config extra", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"zzz":1})))
cases = {
 "slots": [0, 257, -1, True, "2", 1.0],
 "window": [0, 17, True],
 "idle_timeout": [0, 10**12+1],
 "len_quantum": [0, 65536],
 "gap_quantum": [0, 65536],
 "rate_num": [0, 10**6+1],
 "rate_den": [0, 10**6+1],
 "bucket_capacity": [0, 513],
 "pending_capacity": [0, 513],
 "lanes": [0, 5],
}
for k, vals in cases.items():
    for v in vals:
        T("config %s=%r" % (k, v), mutate(None, lambda d, k=k, v=v: d["config"].update({k: v})))
T("initial_tokens > cap", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"initial_tokens": 3})))
T("initial_tokens negative", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"initial_tokens": -1})))
T("service short", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [1]})))
T("service long", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [1,1,1]})))
T("service zero", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [0,1]})))
T("service big", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [10**6+1,1]})))
T("fallback C", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"fallback": 2})))
T("fallback neg", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"fallback": -1})))
T("time_edges first nonzero", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": [1]})))
T("time_edges not increasing", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": [0,0]})))
T("time_edges empty", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": []})))
T("time_edges 17", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": list(range(17))})))
T("time_edges big", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": [0, 10**12+1]})))
T("count_edges big", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"count_edges": [0, 20001]})))
T("count_edges 17", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"count_edges": list(range(17))})))
T("prob shape rows", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[65536]]})))
T("prob shape cols", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[65536,65536]]})))
T("prob value high", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[65537]]})))
T("prob value neg", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[-1]]})))
T("prob not list", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": 5})))
T("prob float", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[1.0]]})))
T("prob bool", mutate(None, lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[True]]})))

# ---- model ----
MK = ["classes","embedding_dim","length_embedding","gap_embedding","kernel","conv_weights",
      "conv_bias","conv_shift","dense_weights","dense_bias"]
for k in MK:
    T("model missing "+k, mutate(None, lambda d, k=k: d["model"].pop(k)))
T("model extra", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"zz":1})))
T("classes 1", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"classes": 1})))
T("classes 9", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"classes": 9})))
T("classes float", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"classes": 2.0})))
T("emb_dim 0", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"embedding_dim": 0})))
T("emb_dim 5", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"embedding_dim": 5})))
T("len_emb short", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"]["length_embedding"].pop()))
T("len_emb row short", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"]["length_embedding"][0].pop()))
T("len_emb value", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"]["length_embedding"][0].append(128)))
T("len_emb value neg", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"]["length_embedding"][0].append(-129)))
T("gap_emb short", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"]["gap_embedding"].pop()))
T("kernel 0", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"kernel": 0})))
T("kernel 6", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"kernel": 6})))
T("kernel > window", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"kernel": 3})))
T("conv_w 9 filters", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": [[[0,0]] for _ in range(9)]})))
T("conv_w empty", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": []})))
T("conv_w k dim", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": [[[0,0],[0,0]]]})))
T("conv_w d dim", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": [[[0]]]})))
T("conv_b len", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_bias": []})))
T("conv_b range", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_bias": [2147483648]})))
T("conv_b range neg", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_bias": [-2147483649]})))
T("conv_shift 17", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_shift": [17]})))
T("conv_shift -1", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_shift": [-1]})))
T("dense_w rows", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_weights": [[0]]})))
T("dense_w cols", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_weights": [[0,0],[0,0]]})))
T("dense_b len", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_bias": [0]})))
T("dense_b range", mutate(None, lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_bias": [0, 2147483648]})))

# ---- connections ----
T("conn missing key", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].pop("slot")))
T("conn extra key", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"z":1})))
T("conn dup id", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"].append({"id":"a","slot":0,"label":0,"split":"dev"})))
T("conn bad id char", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id":"a!"})))
T("conn bad id space", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id":"a b"})))
T("conn id too long", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id":"a"*33})))
T("conn id empty", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id":""})))
T("conn id nonascii", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id":"\u00e9"})))
T("conn id not string", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id":5})))
T("conn slot range", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"slot":2})))
T("conn slot bool", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"slot":True})))
T("conn label range", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"label":2})))
T("conn split bad", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"split":"train"})))
T("conn split null", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"split":None})))
T("conns not list", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"connections": {}})))
T("conns 2049", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"connections": [{"id":"x%d"%i,"slot":0,"label":0,"split":"dev"} for i in range(2049)]})))
V("conns 2048", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"connections": [{"id":"x%d"%i,"slot":0,"label":0,"split":"dev"} for i in range(2048)] + [], "packets": []})))

# ---- packets ----
T("pkt missing key", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].pop("draw")))
T("pkt extra key", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"z":0})))
T("pkt unknown conn", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"connection":"zzz"})))
T("pkt time decreasing", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"].insert(0, {"time":5,"connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0})))
T("pkt time negative", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time":-1})))
T("pkt time big", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time":10**12+1})))
T("pkt length big", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"length":65536})))
T("pkt draw big", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"draw":65536})))
T("pkt draw neg", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"draw":-1})))
T("pkt time bool", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time":False})))
T("pkt time float", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time":1.5})))
T("pkt time string", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time":"0"})))
T("pkt conn not string", mutate(None, lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"connection":1})))
T("pkts 20001", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"packets": [{"time":i,"connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0} for i in range(20001)]})))
T("pkts not list", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"packets": 5})))
V("pkts 20000", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"packets": [{"time":i,"connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0} for i in range(20000)]})))

# ---- valid variants ----
V("empty conns+pkts", json.dumps({"version":1,"config":BASE["config"],"model":BASE["model"],
                                 "connections":[],"packets":[]}))
V("empty pkts only", mutate(None, lambda d: d.update({"packets": []})))
V("leading/trailing ws", "\n\t " + json.dumps(BASE) + "\n  \n")
V("max id chars", mutate(None, lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id":"A"*32})))
V("nan inside string", json.dumps(BASE).replace('"draw"','"na n"'))

print("passed %d/%d" % (sum(results), len(results)))
